title: Barangay directory
description: One entry per barangay, shown on the Everyday Info page. Leave a field as "" until you have verified information; the site shows "Not yet posted" for it.

lastUpdated.description: When this directory was last checked, as YYYY-MM-DD (or "" if never). Shown on the page.

name.description: Official barangay name. Keep it identical to the name in garbage-schedule.json.

captain.description: Punong Barangay (barangay captain), e.g. "Hon. Juan Dela Cruz".

hallAddress.description: Where the barangay hall is, e.g. "Purok 3, along National Highway".

mapUrl.description: Optional Google Maps link to the barangay hall.

hotline.description: Barangay hall phone number as people should read it, e.g. "0912 345 6789".

officials.description: Other barangay officials, in the order to show them.
